main-capability.description: Local application window with a native directory picker and a native save dialog for log export; no filesystem, shell, or hardware permissions. File writing happens in Rust under an extension whitelist. The custom title bar draws its own minimise, maximise/restore and close controls, so those three window commands are granted explicitly: core:window:default exposes only read-only queries (allow-is-*, allow-*-position/size) plus allow-internal-toggle-maximize, and it does NOT include these three. Every call site swallows errors, so a missing grant would make those buttons silently do nothing.
